responsibility: Implements the C-family integration for the Arm backend. It resolves overloaded Arm builtins that need frontend-side type adaptation, especially CDE and MVE-related interfaces, validates and inserts view conversions for polymorphic arguments, defines Arm target preprocessor macros, handles #pragma GCC arm and #pragma GCC target parsing/reconfiguration, updates target-dependent CPP builtins when options change, and registers the target hooks used by C/C++ for overloaded builtin resolution and pragmas.
